summary: Implementation fully conforms to the saved plan. FIX 1 (preserved-failed age cap): gc.py adds DEFAULT_MAX_PRESERVED_FAILED_HOURS=720 and the new, distinct reason code PRESERVED_FAILED_AGE_CAP_RECLAIMED; threads max_preserved_failed_hours through plan_terminal_workspace_gc, run_terminal_workspace_gc, run_service_workspace_gc, and run_workspace_filesystem_gc; computes preserved_failed_cutoff_at in the planner and passes it into both _classify_workspace_for_gc calls (and the filesystem-gc call); and routes aged-out preserved failed/superseded workspaces through the row-preserving candidate reclaim path via a localized _preserved_failed_or_age_capped helper inside _classify_workspace_for_gc, keeping the durable DB row/events/logs since classify never deletes them. FIX 2 (idempotent worktree remove): git_manager.remove_worktree wraps the `git worktree remove --force` call in try/except GitOperationError, re-raising unless exc.stderr (lowercased) contains 'is not a working tree', logging worktree.remove.already_gone and falling through to the existing `git worktree prune`. Scope discipline held: only _classify_workspace_for_gc + the cap config/reason plumbing in gc.py and remove_worktree in git_manager.py were touched; auth_mounts.py and the WS-B2 reconciler were untouched. All planned TDD tests are present (past-cap reclaim asserting candidate + worktree/auth/compose pressure-dir paths, under-cap preserve, no-cutoff default, symmetric superseded branch, reason-code distinctness, planner-level wiring with old reaped / young preserved, stale-metadata removal success with prune still running, and genuine-error re-raise). The sole outstanding gap is missing/insufficient AWF-owned validation evidence: the only validation artifact present is a partial coverage DB (.coverage) measuring just the two changed files under a single empty context, which is not the full 99% gate and carries no pass/fail signal for pytest, ruff check, ruff format --check, or mypy.
